description: Language variants are accepted at 1.0 (D53 lifts G27). The unsuffixed file is the primary and owns the slug, the item IRI and the graph node; <slug>.<lang>.md shares that slug, is published at /<type-plural>/<slug>/<lang>/ and is emitted as language-tagged literals, never as a second item. A variant with no primary is AGSC-E208. Without this vector the whole i18n rule pair AGSC-01-13/01-13a ships unproved.
note: 2026-09-17: BCP 47 tags compare case-insensitively (AR2-33); emitted tags are lower-cased (AGSC-05-31).
reason: Withdrawn at rc.6 (2026-09-24) and superseded by bundle-0007. Language variants (AGSC-01-13, AGSC-01-13a) are reserved to 1.1 by AGSC-00-20, so this case — a shared slug and a variant route at 1.0 — no longer states the 1.0 behaviour, which bundle-0007 states (a second use of the slug, AGSC-E206, no variant route). The case was never a proof of an engine: its handler grouped the paths itself and no reference implementation served a variant, which is why the rule moved rather than the engine; the 1.1 vectors restate this case.
